extensionDescription.message: Adds YouTube controls for RTX Video Super Resolution and Smooth Motion experiments.

popupVsrNote.message: VSR mode shows YouTube's native video layer. non-VSR mode draws video frames into a canvas inside the same player to bypass Chrome's video overlay/VSR display path.

popupNativeNote.message: The native host is still kept for diagnostic scripts that verify the --disable_vp_super_resolution path. The user-facing switch does not open a new Chrome window by default.

smoothDescription.message: Capture and replay the current YouTube image with the built-in presenter.

smoothNote.message: This switch does not restart Chrome. When enabled, the overlay follows play, pause, and seek; it temporarily reveals the native player when YouTube controls are active.

popupVsrStatusEnabled.message: Current mode: VSR native video layer

localSwitcherInstallFirst.message: Native switcher is not installed. Run the installer script first.

buttonVsrEnabledTitle.message: VSR mode: click to switch to in-page non-VSR output

buttonVsrDisabledTitle.message: non-VSR mode: click to restore VSR output

smoothEnabledTitle.message: Smooth Motion overlay: click to close

smoothDisabledTitle.message: Smooth Motion overlay: click to open

noSyncVideoToast.message: No video is available for sync

bgOnlyYouTubeSwitch.message: Only YouTube video pages can be switched.

bgOnlyYouTubeSmooth.message: Only YouTube video pages can use Smooth Motion overlay.
